description: Aggregates tasks across Claude Code task lists and sessions.

evals.name: Aggregate pending tasks across sessions
evals.prompt: What tasks are pending across all my sessions and task lists?
evals.expected_output: Aggregates tasks with pending/in-progress/completed status using --format json, shows dependencies.

evals.name: Find orphaned task lists
evals.prompt: Show me any orphaned task lists in this project.
evals.expected_output: Correctly identifies pending/in-progress tasks whose owning task list's last_modified is >7 days old.

evals.name: Compute orphaned tasks via cross-reference
evals.expected_output: Runs task-lists to get each list's last_modified, then tasks --format json, and computes orphaned status by cross-referencing a task's task_list_id against its owning list's last_modified (>7 days old) rather than trusting any orphaned-like field the tasks output itself might carry.
